review_unit: FAMILY (parent · key children · important interactions · key responsive views · final family). Never every microstate.

flow.writes: review object (status AWAITING_CLIENT) + version + event SENT_TO_CLIENT
flow.client_effect: HOME NEEDS YOU + notification REVIEW READY

flow.writes: receipt APPROVE + approval event (durable) + review status APPROVED
flow.client_effect: APPROVAL SUCCESS with undo window; HOME moves on

flow.action: × NEEDS REVISION → feedback → SEND REVISION REQUEST
flow.writes: receipt REVISION + approval event + status REVISION_REQUESTED
flow.client_effect: REVISION SUBMITTED; HOME no longer waiting on client
NEXT FAMILY READY or FUNDING REQUIRED state

flow.action: sees decision in PW.INBOX client lens + ACTIVITY

states.rule: Two projections of ONE state machine stored once (no duplicate status system).

approve_control.label: APPROVE
approve_control.meaning: The client accepts this authority / family at the current approval gate.

confirmation.STANDARD_GATE: lightweight: inline confirmation state with UNDO for a short grace window (proposed 10 minutes or until founder acts, whichever first)
confirmation.FINAL_OR_CONTRACTUAL_GATE: stronger: explicit confirm modal listing what becomes final

approve_control.reversal: Within grace window: UNDO (event APPROVAL_UNDONE, history kept). After window or once downstream production begins: no silent rewrite — client asks via INBOX; founder issues a new version; approval stays a versioned historical event.

revision_control.label: NEEDS REVISION
revision_control.behaviour: Never submits on tap; expands feedback in place (or focused sheet on mobile).

no_swipe: Swipe gestures are never an approval method.
accessibility: ♥ and × are decorative (aria-hidden); buttons carry text names
state never by colour/symbol alone — status words always shown
focus moves to feedback field on NEEDS REVISION; announced via aria-live
history_shown_to_client: V1 · REVISION REQUESTED · "your words" → V2 · APPROVED — no internal noise.
